notes: Hand-curated summary of US state and territory breach-notification statutes for private-sector entities holding computerised personal information. Deadlines run from the trigger named in deadlineText (discovery vs determination of breach); where the statute only requires notice 'without unreasonable delay' deadlineDays is null. agThreshold 0 means the regulator must be told of every breach that triggers resident notice; null means no regulator-notice duty was identified. creditBureauThreshold uses the same convention. riskOfHarmTrigger is true when the statute lets the entity skip notice after a documented determination that harm is not reasonably likely. Entity-specific regimes (HIPAA, GLBA, state insurance and DFS rules, sector regulators) and law-enforcement delays are not modelled. Statutes change every session: entries carrying confidence 'verify' were amended recently or could not be confirmed with certainty and must be checked against the current code before use. This file is reference data, not legal advice.
